subcategory_text: Manage the security life cycle of in-house developed, hosted, or acquired software to prevent, detect, and remediate security weaknesses before they can impact the enterprise.
implementation_examples: IG1: Apply secure coding; use SAST/SCA in CI
IG2: Run DAST; perform threat modelling
IG3: Penetration testing; runtime application self-protection
assessment_objectives: Determine whether secure SDLC is applied.
Determine whether security tests run in CI.
